title: Design System: Wasp — Variant A (The Corrected Spec)

heading.purpose: Shipped literally, not just its fallback.

motion.registerRationale: PRODUCT.md Brand Personality: developer-tool/product register, transactional 'Get Started' conversion goal — matches kinetic-grid per motion-registers.md selection heuristic.

craft.picked_by: reasoned: literal reading of Wasp's own 'spec document' framing

register.picked_by: reasoned: PRODUCT.md register=brand, dual dev/AI audience

palette.source: inherited from _brand-extraction.json, restricted to declared 5-token system

brand_faithful_inversions.note: Dropped the two undeclared colors (violet, dark-surface) captured on the live page — not part of the design blog's declared system; kept exactly the declared 5.
Corrected heading font from observed IBM Plex Mono fallback to declared JetBrains Mono.

numbered-rail.purpose: structural spec-document navigation, replaces isolated per-section badges

dont: Don't invent new CTA labels not already in current/pages/index.json

iaPriorities.evidence: pages/index.json#ctas — 'Get Started' appears in both nav and hero
pages/index.json#headings — dedicated 'Perfect for AI, by design' section distinct from general developer narrative

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #f7f5f0; padding: 10px 28px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 0px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5c842; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Numbered Rail Item
components.description: One entry in the sticky spec-document TOC rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; border-left: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-rail-item:hover, .ds-rail-item.active { background: #fff3cc; border-left-color: #f5c842; } .ds-rail-num { color: #777777; }

narrative.overview: Every color, font, and corner traces back to Wasp's own declared design law. The numbered-eyebrow idea is taken literally into a structural TOC rail rather than staying decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Exactly five tokens — no undeclared colors
One real modular scale sized off the actual hero
A running numbered rail replaces repeated card-grids

rules.name: The Ratified-Token Rule
rules.body: No color, font, or corner value may exist that isn't traceable to the design blog's declared system.

dos: Ship JetBrains Mono, not just its fallback.
Use literal declared hex values everywhere.
Let the numbered-spec concept restructure the page.
donts: Don't introduce the violet accent or dark surface panel.
